description: Change one item in a collection: set or clear its note (up to 500 characters; an empty note clears it), record the changes made to the track in modifications, or move it to a position in the track order. Fields left out are unchanged.
name: update_collection_item

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.
